newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: APN Holdings, More Group in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: APN Holdings, More Group in joint venture.

text.p: APN Holdings Ltd and More Group Plc on Friday announced plans for an Asia-Pacific joint venture to provide street furniture called Adshel Street Furniture Pty Ltd.
Adshel will acquire all of APN's street furniture assets and contracts, Adshell said in a statement.

These include the entire street furniture business of Australian Posters, plus APN's recently completed acquisition of three smaller street furniture companies UDF and ABS in Sydney and Citysites in Brisbane, Adelaide and Perth.
Street furniture includes items of public amenity such as bus shelters, benches and litter bins.
Irish newspaper publishing group Independent Newspapers Plc has an indirect 23 percent holding in APN through its 52 percent holding in Kelsal.
